items.question: Trong câu "It travels through a chain of environments before reaching real users.", từ "chain" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It travels through a chain of environments before reaching real users.", what does "chain" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: chain /tʃeɪn/ (danh từ): chuỗi nối tiếp nhau. "A chain of environments" = chuỗi môi trường mà phần mềm đi qua; "a chain of stores" lại là chuỗi cửa hàng.
items.explanationEn: chain /tʃeɪn/ (noun): a connected series of stages. "A chain of environments" is the series of stages software passes through; "a chain of stores" is a group of shops.

items.question: Trong câu "Many defect reports turn out to be a user in the wrong environment, or data there differing from real data.", từ "differ" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many defect reports turn out to be a user in the wrong environment, or data there differing from real data.", what does "differ" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: differ /ˈdɪf.ə/ (động từ): khác với. "Differ from something" = khác với cái gì; tính từ: different, danh từ: difference.
items.explanationEn: differ /ˈdɪf.ə/ (verb): to be unlike. "Differ from something" means be unlike it; adjective: different, noun: difference.

items.question: Trong câu "How realistic the staging data must be.", từ "realistic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How realistic the staging data must be.", what does "realistic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: realistic /ˌrɪə.ˈlɪs.tɪk/ (tính từ): sát với thực tế. "Realistic data" = dữ liệu giống thật; "a realistic deadline" = hạn chót khả thi.
items.explanationEn: realistic /ˌrɪə.ˈlɪs.tɪk/ (adjective): close to real life. "Realistic data" resembles real data; "a realistic deadline" is one that can actually be met.

items.question: Trong câu "Testing with 10 records never reveals a performance problem that appears at 10 million.", từ "reveal" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Testing with 10 records never reveals a performance problem that appears at 10 million.", what does "reveal" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reveal /rɪˈviːl/ (động từ): làm lộ ra, cho thấy. "Reveal a problem" = làm lộ ra vấn đề; trái nghĩa: conceal (che giấu).
items.explanationEn: reveal /rɪˈviːl/ (verb): to make known. "Reveal a problem" means bring it to light; the opposite is "conceal".

items.question: Trong câu "Testing with 10 records never reveals a performance problem that appears at 10 million.", từ "record" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Testing with 10 records never reveals a performance problem that appears at 10 million.", what does "record" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: record /ˈrek.ɔːd/ (danh từ): bản ghi dữ liệu. Trong cơ sở dữ liệu, "record" là một bản ghi (một dòng); "break a record" = phá kỷ lục. Động từ đọc /rɪˈkɔːd/.
items.explanationEn: record /ˈrek.ɔːd/ (noun): a single row of data. In a database a "record" is one row; "break a record" means beat the best result. The verb is /rɪˈkɔːd/.

items.question: Trong câu "This needs to be specified explicitly.", từ "explicitly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This needs to be specified explicitly.", what does "explicitly" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách rõ ràng, tường minh
items.explanation: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (trạng từ): một cách rõ ràng, tường minh. "State explicitly" = nói rõ ràng; trái nghĩa: implicitly (ngầm hiểu).
items.explanationEn: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (adverb): clearly and directly. "State explicitly" means say it clearly; the opposite is "implicitly".

items.question: Trong câu "Copying real data to staging without masking phone numbers, emails, and card numbers is a privacy breach.", từ "mask" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Copying real data to staging without masking phone numbers, emails, and card numbers is a privacy breach.", what does "mask" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to hide part of a value
items.explanation: mask /mɑːsk/ (động từ): che bớt, ẩn một phần. "Mask sensitive data" = che thông tin nhạy cảm (ví dụ 0912****89); danh từ "mask" là mặt nạ.
items.explanationEn: mask /mɑːsk/ (verb): to hide part of a value. "Mask sensitive data" means hide parts of it (e.g. ****1234); as a noun, a mask covers the face.

items.question: Trong câu "Copying real data to staging without masking phone numbers, emails, and card numbers is a privacy breach.", từ "breach" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Copying real data to staging without masking phone numbers, emails, and card numbers is a privacy breach.", what does "breach" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: breach /briːtʃ/ (danh từ): sự vi phạm, xâm phạm. "Data breach" = sự cố lộ dữ liệu; "breach of contract" = vi phạm hợp đồng.
items.explanationEn: breach /briːtʃ/ (noun): a violation of a rule. A "data breach" is a leak of data; a "breach of contract" is breaking its terms.

items.question: Trong câu "Nobody thinks of this requirement until there is an incident.", từ "incident" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nobody thinks of this requirement until there is an incident.", what does "incident" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: incident /ˈɪn.sɪ.dənt/ (danh từ): sự cố. "Security incident" = sự cố bảo mật; "incident report" = báo cáo sự cố.
items.explanationEn: incident /ˈɪn.sɪ.dənt/ (noun): an unwanted event. A "security incident" is a harmful event; an "incident report" describes what happened.

items.question: Trong câu "In the test environment, is the payment system a stub or the real one in sandbox mode?", từ "stub" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In the test environment, is the payment system a stub or the real one in sandbox mode?", what does "stub" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: stub /stʌb/ (danh từ): bản giả lập đơn giản. Trong kiểm thử, "stub" là thành phần giả trả về kết quả cố định; đời thường, "ticket stub" là cuống vé.
items.explanationEn: stub /stʌb/ (noun): a simple fake stand-in. In testing, a "stub" is a fake part returning fixed results; in everyday English a "ticket stub" is the torn-off part.

items.question: Trong câu "That difference determines how far you can actually test.", từ "determine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That difference determines how far you can actually test.", what does "determine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: determine /dɪˈtɜː.mɪn/ (động từ): quyết định, chi phối. "X determines Y" = X quyết định Y; nghĩa khác: "determine the cause" = xác định nguyên nhân.
items.explanationEn: determine /dɪˈtɜː.mɪn/ (verb): to decide, to control. "X determines Y" means X controls the outcome of Y; another sense is "determine the cause", to find it out.

items.question: Trong câu "A pull request is opened and a colleague reviews the code.", từ "colleague" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A pull request is opened and a colleague reviews the code.", what does "colleague" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: colleague /ˈkɒl.iːɡ/ (danh từ): đồng nghiệp. "A colleague reviews the code" = một đồng nghiệp review mã; gần nghĩa: co-worker, teammate.
items.explanationEn: colleague /ˈkɒl.iːɡ/ (noun): a co-worker. "A colleague reviews the code" means a co-worker checks it; synonyms: co-worker, teammate.

items.question: Trong câu "Merged to the main branch, where automated tests run.", từ "merge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Merged to the main branch, where automated tests run.", what does "merge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: merge /mɜːdʒ/ (động từ): hợp nhất, gộp vào. "Merge a branch" = gộp nhánh mã; trong kinh doanh, "merger" là sáp nhập công ty.
items.explanationEn: merge /mɜːdʒ/ (verb): to combine into one. "Merge a branch" means combine code into it; in business a "merger" joins two companies.

items.question: Trong câu "Merged to the main branch, where automated tests run.", từ "branch" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Merged to the main branch, where automated tests run.", what does "branch" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a local office of a firm
items.explanation: branch /brɑːntʃ/ (danh từ): nhánh mã nguồn. "Main branch" = nhánh chính trong Git; "bank branch" = chi nhánh ngân hàng.
items.explanationEn: branch /brɑːntʃ/ (noun): a line of code development. The "main branch" is the primary line of code in Git; a "bank branch" is a local office.

items.question: Trong câu "Deployed to staging, where the BA and business users perform UAT.", từ "perform" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Deployed to staging, where the BA and business users perform UAT.", what does "perform" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: perform /pəˈfɔːm/ (động từ): thực hiện, tiến hành. "Perform a test" = tiến hành kiểm thử; "perform on stage" = biểu diễn. Danh từ: performance (hiệu năng / màn trình diễn).
items.explanationEn: perform /pəˈfɔːm/ (verb): to carry out. "Perform a test" means carry it out; "perform on stage" means act. Noun: performance.

items.question: Trong câu "Deployed to production, usually in a planned window.", từ "window" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Deployed to production, usually in a planned window.", what does "window" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: window /ˈwɪn.dəʊ/ (danh từ): khung thời gian. "Maintenance / deployment window" = khung giờ được lên lịch để bảo trì / triển khai.
items.explanationEn: window /ˈwɪn.dəʊ/ (noun): a set period of time. A "maintenance / deployment window" is a scheduled period for that work.

items.question: Trong câu "When reporting progress, state which environment the feature is in", từ "state" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When reporting progress, state which environment the feature is in", what does "state" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: state /steɪt/ (động từ): nêu rõ, phát biểu. "State clearly" = nêu rõ; là danh từ, "state" nghĩa là trạng thái hoặc bang/nhà nước.
items.explanationEn: state /steɪt/ (verb): to say clearly. "State clearly" means say it plainly; as a noun, "state" means a condition or a country.

items.question: Trong câu "If a production deployment fails partway, how do you return to the previous state without losing transactions?", từ "partway" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If a production deployment fails partway, how do you return to the previous state without losing transactions?", what does "partway" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: in the middle of a process
items.explanation: partway /ˌpɑːtˈweɪ/ (trạng từ): giữa chừng. "Fail partway (through)" = hỏng giữa chừng; gần nghĩa: halfway.
items.explanationEn: partway /ˌpɑːtˈweɪ/ (adverb): in the middle of a process. "Fail partway (through)" means stop in the middle; similar: halfway.

items.question: Trong câu "If a production deployment fails partway, how do you return to the previous state without losing transactions?", từ "transaction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If a production deployment fails partway, how do you return to the previous state without losing transactions?", what does "transaction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: transaction /trænˈzæk.ʃən/ (danh từ): giao dịch. "Lose transactions" = mất các giao dịch đã phát sinh; kế hoạch rollback phải tránh điều này.
items.explanationEn: transaction /trænˈzæk.ʃən/ (noun): a business exchange or record. "Lose transactions" means lose exchanges already recorded; a rollback plan must prevent that.

items.question: Trong câu "This is a question the BA should ask before every major release.", từ "major" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is a question the BA should ask before every major release.", what does "major" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: major /ˈmeɪ.dʒə/ (tính từ): lớn, quan trọng. "Major release" = bản phát hành lớn; trái nghĩa: minor. Là danh từ, "major" còn là chuyên ngành đại học.
items.explanationEn: major /ˈmeɪ.dʒə/ (adjective): big and important. A "major release" is a big one; the opposite is "minor". As a noun, a major is a university subject.

items.question: Trong câu "BAs work across many project types, and each demands a different approach.", từ "demand" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BAs work across many project types, and each demands a different approach.", what does "demand" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: demand /dɪˈmɑːnd/ (động từ): đòi hỏi, cần đến. "Demand a different approach" = đòi hỏi cách tiếp cận khác; là danh từ, "demand" là nhu cầu (thị trường).
items.explanationEn: demand /dɪˈmɑːnd/ (verb): to require. "Demand a different approach" means require one; as a noun, "demand" is market need.

items.question: Trong câu "The challenge: everything is ambiguous with no reference point.", từ "reference point" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The challenge: everything is ambiguous with no reference point.", what does "reference point" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: reference point /ˈref.ər.əns pɔɪnt/ (cụm từ): điểm tham chiếu. "No reference point" = không có gì để so sánh, dựa vào; hay gặp ở dự án greenfield.
items.explanationEn: reference point /ˈref.ər.əns pɔɪnt/ (phrase): something to compare against. "No reference point" means nothing to compare with or build on; typical of greenfield projects.

items.question: Trong câu "The biggest challenge: existing requirements are usually documented nowhere, and data migration is seriously underestimated.", từ "underestimate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The biggest challenge: existing requirements are usually documented nowhere, and data migration is seriously underestimated.", what does "underestimate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to judge as larger than it is
to judge as smaller than it is
items.explanation: underestimate /ˌʌn.dərˈes.tɪ.meɪt/ (động từ): đánh giá thấp. "Seriously underestimated" = bị đánh giá thấp nghiêm trọng; trái nghĩa: overestimate.
items.explanationEn: underestimate /ˌʌn.dərˈes.tɪ.meɪt/ (verb): to judge as smaller than it is. "Seriously underestimated" means judged far too small; the opposite is "overestimate".

items.question: Trong câu "The biggest challenge: existing requirements are usually documented nowhere, and data migration is seriously underestimated.", từ "migration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The biggest challenge: existing requirements are usually documented nowhere, and data migration is seriously underestimated.", what does "migration" (noun) mean?
options: chuyển đổi dữ liệu sang hệ thống mới
optionsEn: moving data to a new system
items.explanation: migration /maɪˈɡreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): chuyển đổi dữ liệu sang hệ thống mới. "Data migration" = chuyển dữ liệu từ hệ thống cũ sang mới; nghĩa gốc là sự di cư. Động từ: migrate.
items.explanationEn: migration /maɪˈɡreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): moving data to a new system. "Data migration" moves data from an old system to a new one; the original sense is animals relocating. Verb: migrate.

items.question: Trong câu "Buying commercial software and configuring it.", từ "commercial" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Buying commercial software and configuring it.", what does "commercial" (adjective) mean?
options: thương mại, bán trên thị trường
items.explanation: commercial /kəˈmɜː.ʃəl/ (tính từ): thương mại, bán trên thị trường. "Commercial software" = phần mềm thương mại mua về; là danh từ, "commercial" là quảng cáo trên TV.
items.explanationEn: commercial /kəˈmɜː.ʃəl/ (adjective): sold on the market. "Commercial software" is bought from a vendor; as a noun, a "commercial" is a TV advert.

items.question: Trong câu "The challenge: gap analysis and persuading the organization to change its process rather than customize the code.", từ "persuade" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The challenge: gap analysis and persuading the organization to change its process rather than customize the code.", what does "persuade" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: persuade /pəˈsweɪd/ (động từ): thuyết phục. "Persuade someone to do something" = thuyết phục ai làm gì; danh từ: persuasion.
items.explanationEn: persuade /pəˈsweɪd/ (verb): to convince. "Persuade someone to do something" means convince them; noun: persuasion.

items.question: Trong câu "The challenge: gap analysis and persuading the organization to change its process rather than customize the code.", từ "customize" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The challenge: gap analysis and persuading the organization to change its process rather than customize the code.", what does "customize" (verb) mean?
options: tùy biến theo nhu cầu riêng
items.explanation: customize /ˈkʌs.tə.maɪz/ (động từ): tùy biến theo nhu cầu riêng. "Customize the code" = sửa phần mềm đóng gói cho vừa quy trình riêng; thường tốn kém khi nâng cấp.
items.explanationEn: customize /ˈkʌs.tə.maɪz/ (verb): to adapt for specific needs. "Customize the code" means alter packaged software to fit your own process; it makes upgrades costly.

items.question: Trong câu "The challenge: reconciling metric definitions and source data quality.", từ "reconcile" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The challenge: reconciling metric definitions and source data quality.", what does "reconcile" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reconcile /ˈrek.ən.saɪl/ (động từ): đối chiếu cho khớp nhau. "Reconcile figures / definitions" = đối chiếu cho thống nhất; "reconcile with someone" = làm lành.
items.explanationEn: reconcile /ˈrek.ən.saɪl/ (verb): to make things agree. "Reconcile figures / definitions" means make them consistent; "reconcile with someone" means make peace.

items.question: Trong câu "The challenge: reconciling metric definitions and source data quality.", từ "metric" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The challenge: reconciling metric definitions and source data quality.", what does "metric" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a measure used to track results
items.explanation: metric /ˈmet.rɪk/ (danh từ): chỉ số đo lường. "Metric definitions" = định nghĩa các chỉ số (ví dụ "doanh thu" tính thế nào); "the metric system" = hệ mét.
items.explanationEn: metric /ˈmet.rɪk/ (noun): a measure used to track results. "Metric definitions" say how each measure is calculated; "the metric system" is the metre-based system.

items.question: Trong câu "The answer decides where your effort goes — eliciting from scratch, eliciting from a legacy system, or gap analysis against a package.", từ "from scratch" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The answer decides where your effort goes — eliciting from scratch, eliciting from a legacy system, or gap analysis against a package.", what does "from scratch" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: from scratch /frɒm skrætʃ/ (cụm từ): từ con số không. "Start from scratch" = bắt đầu lại từ đầu, không có gì sẵn.
items.explanationEn: from scratch /frɒm skrætʃ/ (phrase): from the very beginning. "Start from scratch" means begin with nothing already in place.

items.question: Trong câu "The answer decides where your effort goes — eliciting from scratch, eliciting from a legacy system, or gap analysis against a package.", từ "legacy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The answer decides where your effort goes — eliciting from scratch, eliciting from a legacy system, or gap analysis against a package.", what does "legacy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: legacy /ˈleɡ.ə.si/ (tính từ): cũ, kế thừa từ trước. "Legacy system" = hệ thống cũ vẫn đang chạy; là danh từ, "legacy" là di sản / tài sản thừa kế.
items.explanationEn: legacy /ˈleɡ.ə.si/ (adjective): old but still in use. A "legacy system" is old but still running; as a noun, a legacy is something left to heirs.

items.question: Trong câu "The answer decides where your effort goes — eliciting from scratch, eliciting from a legacy system, or gap analysis against a package.", từ "package" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The answer decides where your effort goes — eliciting from scratch, eliciting from a legacy system, or gap analysis against a package.", what does "package" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: package /ˈpæk.ɪdʒ/ (danh từ): gói phần mềm đóng sẵn. "Gap analysis against a package" = so sánh nhu cầu với phần mềm đóng gói; "salary package" = gói đãi ngộ.
items.explanationEn: package /ˈpæk.ɪdʒ/ (noun): a ready-made software product. "Gap analysis against a package" compares needs with ready-made software; a "salary package" is a pay deal.

items.question: Trong câu "These are very different working environments, and the choice between them shapes a BA career.", từ "shape" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These are very different working environments, and the choice between them shapes a BA career.", what does "shape" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shape /ʃeɪp/ (động từ): định hình, ảnh hưởng lớn. "Shape a career / direction" = định hình sự nghiệp / hướng đi; danh từ "shape" là hình dạng.
items.explanationEn: shape /ʃeɪp/ (verb): to strongly influence. "Shape a career / direction" means strongly influence it; as a noun, shape is form.

items.question: Trong câu "More of it, since it underpins the contract", từ "underpin" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "More of it, since it underpins the contract", what does "underpin" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: underpin /ˌʌn.dəˈpɪn/ (động từ): làm nền tảng, chống đỡ. "Documentation underpins the contract" = tài liệu là nền tảng cho hợp đồng outsource.
items.explanationEn: underpin /ˌʌn.dəˈpɪn/ (verb): to support from below. "Documentation underpins the contract" means it forms the basis of the outsourcing agreement.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA executes the customer's requirements", từ "execute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA executes the customer's requirements", what does "execute" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: execute /ˈek.sɪ.kjuːt/ (động từ): thực hiện, triển khai. "Execute requirements / a plan" = thực hiện theo; "execute code" = chạy mã; nghĩa khác là xử tử.
items.explanationEn: execute /ˈek.sɪ.kjuːt/ (verb): to carry out. "Execute requirements / a plan" means carry it out; "execute code" means run it; another sense is to put to death.

items.question: Trong câu "A product company suits you if you want:", từ "suit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A product company suits you if you want:", what does "suit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: suit /suːt/ (động từ): phù hợp với. "X suits you" = X phù hợp với bạn; danh từ "suit" là bộ com-lê; tính từ: suitable.
items.explanationEn: suit /suːt/ (verb): to be right for. "X suits you" means it is right for you; as a noun, a suit is formal clothing; adjective: suitable.

items.question: Trong câu "depth in one field, seeing a product evolve over years, participating in product decisions.", từ "evolve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "depth in one field, seeing a product evolve over years, participating in product decisions.", what does "evolve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: evolve /ɪˈvɒlv/ (động từ): phát triển dần, tiến hóa. "A product evolves" = sản phẩm phát triển dần qua thời gian; danh từ: evolution.
items.explanationEn: evolve /ɪˈvɒlv/ (verb): to develop gradually. "A product evolves" means it develops gradually; noun: evolution.

items.question: Trong câu "exposure to many industries, fast learning across project types, sharpened customer-facing and documentation skills.", từ "exposure" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "exposure to many industries, fast learning across project types, sharpened customer-facing and documentation skills.", what does "exposure" (noun) mean?
options: cơ hội tiếp xúc, trải nghiệm
items.explanation: exposure /ɪkˈspəʊ.ʒə/ (danh từ): cơ hội tiếp xúc, trải nghiệm. "Exposure to many industries" = được tiếp xúc nhiều ngành; "exposure to risk" = mức độ chịu rủi ro.
items.explanationEn: exposure /ɪkˈspəʊ.ʒə/ (noun): experience of something. "Exposure to many industries" means experiencing many of them; "exposure to risk" means being open to it.

items.question: Trong câu "exposure to many industries, fast learning across project types, sharpened customer-facing and documentation skills.", từ "sharpen" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "exposure to many industries, fast learning across project types, sharpened customer-facing and documentation skills.", what does "sharpen" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: sharpen /ˈʃɑː.pən/ (động từ): mài giũa, nâng cao. "Sharpen your skills" = mài giũa kỹ năng; nghĩa đen là mài cho sắc.
items.explanationEn: sharpen /ˈʃɑː.pən/ (verb): to improve a skill. "Sharpen your skills" means make them better; literally, to make an edge sharper.

items.question: Trong câu "exposure to many industries, fast learning across project types, sharpened customer-facing and documentation skills.", từ "customer-facing" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "exposure to many industries, fast learning across project types, sharpened customer-facing and documentation skills.", what does "customer-facing" (adjective) mean?
options: làm việc trực tiếp với khách hàng
items.explanation: customer-facing /ˈkʌs.tə.mə ˌfeɪ.sɪŋ/ (tính từ): làm việc trực tiếp với khách hàng. "Customer-facing role / skills" = vai trò / kỹ năng giao tiếp trực tiếp với khách hàng.
items.explanationEn: customer-facing /ˈkʌs.tə.mə ˌfeɪ.sɪŋ/ (adjective): dealing directly with clients. A "customer-facing role" involves direct contact with clients.

items.question: Trong câu "How business rules are implemented, API contracts, data impact", từ "implement" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How business rules are implemented, API contracts, data impact", what does "implement" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: implement /ˈɪm.plɪ.ment/ (động từ): hiện thực hóa, triển khai. "Implement a rule / feature" = hiện thực hóa trong mã; danh từ "implement" lại là nông cụ.
items.explanationEn: implement /ˈɪm.plɪ.ment/ (verb): to put into effect. "Implement a rule / feature" means build it into the system; as a noun, an implement is a tool.

items.question: Trong câu "Ask a tech lead when: you need the architectural impact of a change, whether a requirement is feasible", từ "feasible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ask a tech lead when: you need the architectural impact of a change, whether a requirement is feasible", what does "feasible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: feasible /ˈfiː.zə.bəl/ (tính từ): khả thi. "Technically feasible" = khả thi về kỹ thuật; danh từ: feasibility ("feasibility study" = nghiên cứu khả thi).
items.explanationEn: feasible /ˈfiː.zə.bəl/ (adjective): possible to do. "Technically feasible" means it can be done; noun: feasibility ("feasibility study").

items.question: Trong câu "A common beginner mistake: directing every question at one person.", từ "direct" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A common beginner mistake: directing every question at one person.", what does "direct" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: direct /daɪˈrekt/ (động từ): hướng (câu hỏi) vào. "Direct a question at / to someone" = đặt câu hỏi cho ai; "direct a film" = đạo diễn phim.
items.explanationEn: direct /daɪˈrekt/ (verb): to aim at. "Direct a question at someone" means address it to them; "direct a film" means lead its making.

items.question: Trong câu "Asking a tech lead about usability, or a designer about architectural impact, produces answers you should not rely on.", từ "rely on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Asking a tech lead about usability, or a designer about architectural impact, produces answers you should not rely on.", what does "rely on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rely on /rɪˈlaɪ ɒn/ (cụm từ): tin cậy, dựa vào. "Rely on someone / something" = dựa vào, tin cậy; tính từ: reliable (đáng tin cậy).
items.explanationEn: rely on /rɪˈlaɪ ɒn/ (phrase): to depend on. "Rely on something" means depend on it; adjective: reliable.

items.question: Trong câu "They hold the final say on technical decisions, code review, and architectural direction", từ "final say" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They hold the final say on technical decisions, code review, and architectural direction", what does "final say" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: the right to decide in the end
items.explanation: final say /ˈfaɪ.nəl seɪ/ (cụm từ): quyền quyết định cuối cùng. "Have the final say" = có tiếng nói quyết định cuối cùng.
items.explanationEn: final say /ˈfaɪ.nəl seɪ/ (phrase): the right to decide in the end. "Have the final say" means make the ultimate decision.

items.question: Trong câu "They build and run infrastructure, automated deployment pipelines, and monitoring.", từ "infrastructure" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They build and run infrastructure, automated deployment pipelines, and monitoring.", what does "infrastructure" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: infrastructure /ˈɪn.frəˌstrʌk.tʃə/ (danh từ): hạ tầng (máy chủ, mạng). "IT infrastructure" = hạ tầng CNTT (máy chủ, mạng, lưu trữ); nghĩa rộng: đường sá, cầu cống.
items.explanationEn: infrastructure /ˈɪn.frəˌstrʌk.tʃə/ (noun): servers, networks and platforms. "IT infrastructure" is servers, networks and storage; in general use it also means roads and bridges.

items.question: Trong câu "They build and run infrastructure, automated deployment pipelines, and monitoring.", từ "pipeline" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They build and run infrastructure, automated deployment pipelines, and monitoring.", what does "pipeline" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a tube for oil or gas
items.explanation: pipeline /ˈpaɪp.laɪn/ (danh từ): chuỗi bước tự động. "Deployment pipeline" = chuỗi bước tự động build – test – deploy; "sales pipeline" = phễu khách hàng tiềm năng.
items.explanationEn: pipeline /ˈpaɪp.laɪn/ (noun): a series of automated steps. A "deployment pipeline" automates build, test and deploy; a "sales pipeline" tracks likely deals.

items.question: Trong câu "you need to know how long a release takes, how much load the system handles, what logs exist for investigating incidents, and how data is backed up.", từ "load" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "you need to know how long a release takes, how much load the system handles, what logs exist for investigating incidents, and how data is backed up.", what does "load" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: load /ləʊd/ (danh từ): tải (lượng yêu cầu). "How much load the system handles" = hệ thống chịu được bao nhiêu tải; "load testing" = kiểm thử tải.
items.explanationEn: load /ləʊd/ (noun): the amount of work demanded. "How much load the system handles" is how much traffic it can take; "load testing" measures it.

items.question: Trong câu "you need to know how long a release takes, how much load the system handles, what logs exist for investigating incidents, and how data is backed up.", từ "investigate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "you need to know how long a release takes, how much load the system handles, what logs exist for investigating incidents, and how data is backed up.", what does "investigate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to examine to find the cause
items.explanation: investigate /ɪnˈves.tɪ.ɡeɪt/ (động từ): điều tra, tìm nguyên nhân. "Investigate an incident" = điều tra sự cố; danh từ: investigation.
items.explanationEn: investigate /ɪnˈves.tɪ.ɡeɪt/ (verb): to examine to find the cause. "Investigate an incident" means look into its cause; noun: investigation.

items.question: Trong câu "you need to know how long a release takes, how much load the system handles, what logs exist for investigating incidents, and how data is backed up.", từ "back up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "you need to know how long a release takes, how much load the system handles, what logs exist for investigating incidents, and how data is backed up.", what does "back up" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: back up /bæk ʌp/ (cụm từ): sao lưu. "Back up data" = sao lưu dữ liệu (danh từ viết liền: backup); "back someone up" = ủng hộ ai.
items.explanationEn: back up /bæk ʌp/ (phrase): to make a safety copy. "Back up data" means copy it for safety (noun: backup); "back someone up" means support them.

items.question: Trong câu "Nonfunctional requirements usually need verifying with DevOps", từ "verify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nonfunctional requirements usually need verifying with DevOps", what does "verify" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to check that it is true
items.explanation: verify /ˈver.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): xác minh, kiểm chứng. "Verify with someone" = kiểm chứng lại với ai; danh từ: verification.
items.explanationEn: verify /ˈver.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to check that it is true. "Verify with someone" means confirm it with them; noun: verification.

items.question: Trong câu "they know what the current infrastructure can bear.", từ "bear" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "they know what the current infrastructure can bear.", what does "bear" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bear /beə/ (động từ): chịu đựng được. "Can bear" = chịu được (tải, áp lực); "bear in mind" = ghi nhớ; danh từ "bear" là con gấu.
items.explanationEn: bear /beə/ (verb): to withstand. "Can bear" means can withstand; "bear in mind" means remember; as a noun, a bear is an animal.

items.question: Trong câu "QA (quality assurance) focuses on improving the process so fewer defects appear.", từ "assurance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "QA (quality assurance) focuses on improving the process so fewer defects appear.", what does "assurance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: assurance /əˈʃʊə.rəns/ (danh từ): sự đảm bảo. "Quality assurance" = đảm bảo chất lượng qua quy trình; ở Anh, "life assurance" là bảo hiểm nhân thọ.
items.explanationEn: assurance /əˈʃʊə.rəns/ (noun): a guarantee of quality. "Quality assurance" secures quality through process; in British English "life assurance" is insurance.

items.question: Trong câu "Many companies use the terms interchangeably.", từ "interchangeably" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many companies use the terms interchangeably.", what does "interchangeably" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: interchangeably /ˌɪn.təˈtʃeɪn.dʒə.bli/ (trạng từ): thay thế cho nhau. "Use terms interchangeably" = dùng các thuật ngữ như thể cùng nghĩa; tính từ: interchangeable.
items.explanationEn: interchangeably /ˌɪn.təˈtʃeɪn.dʒə.bli/ (adverb): in place of each other. "Use terms interchangeably" means treat them as the same; adjective: interchangeable.

items.question: Trong câu "Many companies use the terms interchangeably.", từ "term" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many companies use the terms interchangeably.", what does "term" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: term /tɜːm/ (danh từ): thuật ngữ. "Technical term" = thuật ngữ kỹ thuật; "terms and conditions" = điều khoản hợp đồng.
items.explanationEn: term /tɜːm/ (noun): a word for a concept. A "technical term" is a specialist word; "terms and conditions" are contract clauses.

items.question: Trong câu "A useful observation: DevOps and tech leads are the two roles BAs most often skip during analysis, then have to consult late", từ "observation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A useful observation: DevOps and tech leads are the two roles BAs most often skip during analysis, then have to consult late", what does "observation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: observation /ˌɒb.zəˈveɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): nhận xét rút ra. "A useful observation" = một nhận xét hữu ích; "under observation" = đang bị theo dõi.
items.explanationEn: observation /ˌɒb.zəˈveɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a remark based on noticing. "A useful observation" is a helpful remark; "under observation" means being watched.

items.question: Trong câu "A useful observation: DevOps and tech leads are the two roles BAs most often skip during analysis, then have to consult late", từ "consult" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A useful observation: DevOps and tech leads are the two roles BAs most often skip during analysis, then have to consult late", what does "consult" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to look up in a book
items.explanation: consult /kənˈsʌlt/ (động từ): hỏi ý kiến. "Consult someone" = hỏi ý kiến ai; "consult a dictionary" = tra từ điển; "consultant" = chuyên viên tư vấn.
items.explanationEn: consult /kənˈsʌlt/ (verb): to ask for advice. "Consult someone" means ask their advice; "consult a dictionary" means look something up.

items.question: Trong câu "precisely when changes have become expensive.", từ "precisely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "precisely when changes have become expensive.", what does "precisely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: precisely /prɪˈsaɪs.li/ (trạng từ): đúng vào, chính xác là. "Precisely when..." = đúng vào lúc...; "precisely!" còn dùng để đồng ý hoàn toàn.
items.explanationEn: precisely /prɪˈsaɪs.li/ (adverb): exactly. "Precisely when..." means exactly at the time...; "Precisely!" also signals full agreement.

items.question: Trong câu "Three things BAs miss: how realistic staging data is, masking sensitive data, and stub versus sandbox for integrations.", từ "sensitive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three things BAs miss: how realistic staging data is, masking sensitive data, and stub versus sandbox for integrations.", what does "sensitive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sensitive /ˈsen.sɪ.tɪv/ (tính từ): nhạy cảm, cần bảo mật. "Sensitive data" = dữ liệu nhạy cảm (số thẻ, số điện thoại...); "case-sensitive" = phân biệt hoa thường.
items.explanationEn: sensitive /ˈsen.sɪ.tɪv/ (adjective): needing protection. "Sensitive data" must be protected (card numbers, phones...); "case-sensitive" means upper and lower case differ.

items.question: Trong câu "Product companies give deep domain knowledge; outsourcing gives breadth and stricter documentation habits.", từ "breadth" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Product companies give deep domain knowledge; outsourcing gives breadth and stricter documentation habits.", what does "breadth" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: breadth /bredθ/ (danh từ): sự rộng, bề rộng. "Breadth vs depth" = rộng hay sâu; đừng nhầm với "breath" /breθ/ (hơi thở).
items.explanationEn: breadth /bredθ/ (noun): wide range. "Breadth vs depth" contrasts range with deep expertise; do not confuse it with "breath".

items.question: Trong câu "Outsourcing usually teaches beginners faster because of the volume of projects in a short time.", từ "volume" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Outsourcing usually teaches beginners faster because of the volume of projects in a short time.", what does "volume" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: volume /ˈvɒl.juːm/ (danh từ): số lượng lớn, khối lượng. "The volume of projects" = số lượng dự án; "turn up the volume" = tăng âm lượng.
items.explanationEn: volume /ˈvɒl.juːm/ (noun): a large amount. "The volume of projects" is how many there are; "turn up the volume" means make it louder.

items.question: Trong câu "Each IT project type demands a different analysis approach, so identify the type at the outset.", từ "at the outset" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each IT project type demands a different analysis approach, so identify the type at the outset.", what does "at the outset" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at the outset /æt ði ˈaʊt.set/ (cụm từ): ngay từ đầu. "At the outset" = ngay lúc bắt đầu; gần nghĩa: from the start.
items.explanationEn: at the outset /æt ði ˈaʊt.set/ (phrase): at the start. "At the outset" means at the beginning; similar: from the start.

items.question: Trong câu "Product and outsourcing are two different career paths, each sharpening a distinct skill set.", từ "distinct" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Product and outsourcing are two different career paths, each sharpening a distinct skill set.", what does "distinct" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distinct /dɪˈstɪŋkt/ (tính từ): riêng biệt, khác biệt. "A distinct skill set" = bộ kỹ năng riêng biệt; nghĩa khác: "a distinct smell" = mùi rõ rệt.
items.explanationEn: distinct /dɪˈstɪŋkt/ (adjective): clearly separate. "A distinct skill set" is clearly different; another sense: "a distinct smell" is easy to notice.
